title: Long-Range Video Presentation Attack Detection: A Three-Class Benchmark Across 1-100 m and Two Sensor Types
abstract: arXiv:2611.25108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) systems deployed in border control and airport surveillance are constrained by a critical assumption: subjects are captured at close range, typically under one meter. No existing benchmark systematically addresses multi-distance capture, diverse environmental conditions, and concurrent spoofing and occlusion-based attacks, leaving deployed models underprepared for real-world scenarios. We introduce a video-based PAD dataset of 374,000+ frames from 261 unique identities collected across five standoff distances (1 m-100 m) under indoor and outdoor conditions using a DSLR camera (C) and a mobile sensor (M), with three-class labels: live, spoof, and props (occlusions); models are trained and evaluated on video clips rather than single frames. translated_title: 长距离视频呈现攻击检测：跨1-100米距离与两种传感器类型的三分类基准
translated_abstract: 部署在边境管控和机场监控中的人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）系统受到一个关键假设的限制：目标对象在近距离拍摄，通常在一米以内。目前尚无现有基准系统地解决多距离采集、多样化环境条件以及欺骗攻击与遮挡攻击并存的问题，这使得已部署的模型在面对真实场景时准备不足。我们引入了一个基于视频的PAD数据集，包含来自261个独特身份的37万余帧图像，数据在室内和室外条件下、使用单反相机（DSLR，C）和移动传感器（M）在五个 standoff 距离（1米至100米）采集，并带有三分类标签：真人、欺骗攻击和道具（遮挡）；模型在视频片段而非单帧上进行训练和评估。我们对四种CNN架构进行了微调和基准测试：MobileNetV3、MobileNet、EfficientNet和ResNet-50。分辨率更高的DSLR相机保持了接近完美的欺骗分类性能……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向长距离场景的视频人脸呈现攻击检测基准，涵盖1-100米五种拍摄距离、室内外环境、两种传感器类型及真人/欺骗/道具三分类标签（37万余帧、261个身份），并对四种CNN架构进行微调与评测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first long-range video face presentation attack detection benchmark spanning 1-100 m across five standoff distances, indoor/outdoor conditions, two sensor types, and three-class labels (live/spoof/props), with over 374,000 frames from 261 identities and fine-tuned benchmarks on four CNN architectures.
